findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "instagram-scraper" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_basic_engagement, get_business, get_comments, get_music_search, get_posts, get_posts_username, get_post_info, get_post_info_v2, get_randusername, get_reels_posts, get_reels_posts_username, get_tv_posts, get_tv_posts_username · Private data: get_noCORS · Public sink: get_business, get_post_info, get_post_info_v2 · Destructive: get_get_stories_hd, get_stories_hd.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_basic_engagement, get_business, get_comments, get_music_search, get_posts, get_posts_username, get_post_info, get_post_info_v2, get_randusername, get_reels_posts, get_reels_posts_username, get_tv_posts, get_tv_posts_username · Private data: get_noCORS · Public sink: get_business, get_post_info, get_post_info_v2 · Destructive: get_get_stories_hd, get_stories_hd

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
